_README: OWNER INPUT. Fill in ONLY what is real and public. Leave a field empty ([] or null) and it is simply not published. Then run:  python3 tools/apply-owner-info.py   (from the site folder) and upload the changed files.
_socialProfiles_help: Official profile web addresses only, for example https://www.linkedin.com/company/your-page . No personal pages, no pages you do not control.
_publicPhone_help: A phone number you want the public to call, with country code, for example +1 713 555 0100. Leave null to publish none.
_officeHours_help: Example: [{"office": "Houston", "days": ["Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday"], "opens": "09:00", "closes": "17:00"}]  (24-hour times, local time of that office).
_primaryOffice_help: "Houston" or "Lahore". The primary office is listed first in the structured data.
_serviceAreas_help: Countries or regions where you really serve clients, for example ["United States", "Pakistan"].
_articles_help: For each article: the real author's full name, the publication date and the last update date, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave null if unknown. They are added to the article's structured data only.
_aiTrainingCrawlers_help: null = leave as it is (all crawlers allowed). "allow" = same. "block" = also ask OpenAI, Anthropic, Google-Extended and Apple-Extended training crawlers not to use the site; normal search crawlers and AI answer/search crawlers stay allowed.
